record.paper_title: Higher Rank Brill-Noether Theory and Coherent Systems: Open Questions
record.original_question: Let C be a general smooth curve of genus g >= 1, and let (E,V) be a general generated coherent system in S_0(n,d,k). Is the dual-span bundle D_{E,V} semistable?

evidence.quote: Question 5.1. For a general (E, V ) ∈ S0(n, d, k) on a general curve C of genus g ≥ 1, is DE,V semistable?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C$ be a general smooth projective curve of genus $g\ge 1$ over $\mathbb{C}$. A coherent system of type $(n,d,k)$ on $C$ is a pair $(E,V)$ where $E$ is a vector bundle on $C$ of rank $n$ and degree $d$, and $V\subseteq H^0(E)$ is a linear subspace of dimension $k$. The coherent system $(E,V)$ is called generated if the evaluation map $V\otimes \mathcal{O}_C \to E$ is surjective; in this case one has a short exact sequence
$$0 \longrightarrow M_{E,V} \longrightarrow V\otimes \mathcal{O}_C \longrightarrow E \longrightarrow 0,$$
and the dual-span bundle is defined by $D_{E,V} := M_{E,V}^{\vee}$, a vector bundle of rank $k-n$ and degree $d$. Let $S_0(n,d,k)$ denote the moduli space of generated coherent systems of type $(n,d,k)$ on $C$ for which $E$ is semistable (equivalently, for which $h^0(E^*)=0$ so that the dual-span construction yields a coherent system $(D_{E,V}, V^*)$).

Question: for a general curve $C$ of genus $g\ge 1$ and a general $(E,V)\in S_0(n,d,k)$, is the dual-span bundle $D_{E,V}$ semistable?
artifact.status_search_result: This is a form of Butler's conjecture on the (semi)stability of the dual span bundle of a general generated coherent system. It remains open in general, but multiple partial results are known: stability has been established in special ranges (e.g. type (2,d,4) and (2,d,5) under linear stability hypotheses), and recent works (2023–2024) continue to make progress using linear stability and α-stability techniques, without resolving the full conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Linear stability of coherent systems and applications to Butler's conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Shows that linearly stable coherent systems of type (2,d,4) for low d have stable DSB, proving a particular case of a generalized Butler conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results on Butler's conjecture continue to appear; the full conjecture is not yet resolved.

status_evidence.title: On α-stability and linear stability of generated coherent systems
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs systems with stable dual span bundle and proves a case of Butler's conjecture for type (2,d,5).
status_evidence.claim: Special cases proven; general case remains open.

status_evidence.title: On Generated Coherent Systems and a Conjecture of D. C. Butler
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Butler's conjecture on stability of dual span bundles.
